name: email_draft_received_return_inspection_status
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: Draft a reply explaining that received return R90 will be refunded within 5 business days of inspection, citing policy
tests: the agent reads Iris West's email thread th_r05_refund_status, checks return R90, consults ret_pol_v3, and drafts a reply stating the item was received and refund will be issued within 5 business days after inspection
instruction:
You emailed support (subject 'When will my refund for R90 arrive?') asking when you will receive your refund for return R90. You are contacting support in chat asking them to draft a reply to your email thread explaining the refund timeline.

Your details:
- Name: Iris West
- Email: iris.west@example.com
- Postal Code: 63101
- Order ID: O29
- Return ID: R90

persona.name: Iris West
persona.initial_message: Hello, I sent an email regarding my return R90. Could you please reply to my email thread with the status and when the refund will be processed?

arguments.subject: Re: When will my refund for R90 arrive
arguments.body: Hello Iris, your return R90 has been received and is undergoing inspection. According to our Returns Policy, refunds are issued within 5 business days after inspection.

fixed.replyToMessageId: record: message rmsg_007 in thread th_r05_refund_status
